item.name: Ancient Beast
item.overview: The Ancient Beast is located on the 5th floor of a dungeon, typically being the first boss the player faces on any difficulty. He has 2 phases, similar to rip_indra True Form.

item.name: Awakened Ice Admiral
item.overview: The Awakened Ice Admiral wears a pair of light blue pants and vest, a very dark red (almost brown) dress shirt, a green bowtie and the Marine version of the Coat on his back. He also has bushy eyebrows, stubble on his chin and upper lip, and slicked brown hair.

item.name: Beautiful Pirate
item.overview: The Beautiful Pirate has two appearances:

item.name: Bobby
item.overview: Bobby had a clown nose with blue hair, a cross-bone tattoo across his face with two scars cutting through each eye, an orange pirate hat with black shoes, some white pants with a blue belt and a green and white striped shirt with red gloves. He also wore a red scarf around his neck bearing a green gem bordered with yellow casing.

item.name: Cake Queen
item.overview: Server hopping for the Cake Queen is a good way to farm mastery, money and Bounty/Honor. Her health and damage output is very high, so if possible, the player should get a good powerful fruit (such as Buddha), sword, and/or other people to assist them.

item.name: Captain Elephant
item.overview: Captain Elephant wears a damaged brown shirt with purple pants and brown shoes with yellow hair and the Jaw Shield in his mouth. He also has grey skin and uses Aura.

item.name: Chef
item.overview: The Chef is located in the Pirate Village, outside the yellow house in front of the Brutes.

item.name: Chief Warden
item.overview: The Chief Warden wears a pair of emerald-green cargo shorts with silver, diamond shaped studs, and brown shoes. He has an Egyptian headdress, with black bat-like wings growing from his back. He does not wear a shirt, and his chest is consequently visible.

item.name: Core
item.overview: The Core spawns in 1 hour and 30 minutes. When the Factory Raid starts, players have five minutes to destroy the core. Otherwise, the door will close, and a poison will spread, killing all players who are still in the factory.

item.name: Cursed Skeleton Boss
item.overview: The Cursed Skeleton Boss is located at the Crypt, at Floating Turtle, in Third Sea.

item.name: Cyborg (Boss)
item.overview: The Cyborg has a robotic left arm with a blue vest, yellow shirt, and black pants with snow white spiky hair. Cyborg is also wearing blue goggles and iron nails on his face. He uses Rocket as his main attacking method.

item.name: Diamond (Boss)
item.overview: Diamond is a tall, medium-sized man with a variety of leaves forming a shape behind his head. He also wears a green shirt which exposes his chest, along with brown pants with some visuals in it.

item.name: Don Swan
item.overview: Don Swan wears a black robe with maroon stripes, which is short enough to reveal muscles on his arms and torso, and maroon shoes. On his back, he wears the Pink Coat, and has black, spiky hair, a large, toothy grin, as well as a pair of Swan Glasses.

item.name: Fajita
item.overview: Fajita had brown, bushy hair, eyebrows and a beard, and a straight scar across the top of his nose. He wore the marine version of the Coat with golden decoration and a black collar, a green robe with a maroon edge, and brown pants. He also held the Gravity Blade.

item.name: Fishman Lord
item.overview: The Fishman Lord has two appearances which are:

item.name: Gas Knight
item.overview: The Gas Knight is located on the 15th floor of a dungeon. He is the final boss on Easy Mode, not in Hard and Challenge mode (Due to Zero being the last).

item.name: Gorilla God
item.overview: The Gorilla God can be found in the Dungeons, in one of the random floors on Hard Mode leading up to Zero.

item.name: Heaven's Guardian
item.overview: The Heaven's Guardian appears after lighting up the third torch in the Soulless scroll quest. He uses the awakened old version of the Light fruit and he possesses the Angel race but doesn't have any abilities or buffs from it. Most of his attacks cannot be dodged because of the fast start-up of the moves. He also utilizes Aura.

item.name: Hell's Messenger
item.overview: The Hell's Messenger appears after lighting up the third torch in the Fear the Reaper scroll quest. He uses the awakened version of the Dark fruit and also utilizes Aura. He is easier to beat than Heaven's Guardian mostly due to the attacks being easy to dodge.

item.name: Hydra Leader
item.overview: The Hydra Leader wears a black and purple outfit and a purple band around her waist. She has a black mask covering the majority of her face and wear a black conical hat on her head. Her outfit is similar to the Venomous Assailants'.

item.name: Ice Admiral
item.overview: The Ice Admiral wears a white suit vest, and white pants, along with a red dress shirt underneath. He also has a green bowtie, black shoes, combed hair, and bushy eyebrows. He wears the marine version of the Coat, which hangs off his back, and has visible muscles on his legs and arms.

item.name: Island Empress
item.overview: The Island Empress spawned every 25 minutes. She was located in front of the palace at the Hydra Island in the Third Sea.

item.name: Jeremy
item.overview: Jeremy wears a pink T-shirt with white pants with black shoes and a black ribbon on his pants with yellow hair and sunglasses that cover his eyes.

item.name: Kilo Admiral
item.overview: The Kilo Admiral wears green clothes with watermelon images, green bracelets, dark green shoes, a green helmet covering brown hair, a green umbrella on her head, and the Lei on her neck. She uses the Winky face.

item.name: Kitsune Lord
item.overview: The Kitsune Lord is location on the 10th floor of a dungeon. He is the second boss the player faces at any difficulty.

item.name: Longma
item.overview: Longma is located at the Floating Turtle, behind a door near the Previous Hero. This boss is only accessible after completing the Tushita Puzzle in the Third Sea.

item.name: Magma Admiral
item.overview: The Magma Admiral stands with resolve, wearing a white long coat that drapes from his torso to his lower leg (not be confused with the coat on his back). He is seen with a deep blue shirt that is similar to a marine uniform, and simple black pants. His headwear includes a pale white cap that says "MARINE", and he has a distinct white coat that hangs on his back like a cape.

item.name: Mob Leader
item.overview: The Mob Leader wears a black and gray shirt and pants with black hair, he uses the face "Hmmm".

item.name: Orbitus
item.overview: Orbitus can be found at the Green Zone island in Second Sea. To find him, the player can walk straight and then to the right from the Marine Quest Giver.

item.name: Red Legionnaire
item.overview: The Red Legionnaires arrive during a raid upon the Spirit Tree of the Celestial Domain.

item.name: Rip indra
item.overview: rip_indra takes the appearance of the admin rip_indra's old avatar.

item.name: Rip Legionnaire
item.overview: The Rip Legionnaires arrive during a raid upon the Spirit Tree of the Oni Realm

item.name: Rip return
item.overview: rip_return has white legs and torso, with blue arms, and a necklace. He wears a silver pumpkin on his head with protruding horns. He also has a pair of angel wings. The model is a representation of the developer, rip_return's Roblox avatar.

item.name: Saber Expert
item.overview: The Saber Expert has red hair, wears a white vest-type shirt and a black cape and has brown to black pants. He has a short beard and a small moustache and he bears a double scar beneath his left eye.

item.name: Smoke Admiral
item.overview: The Smoke Admiral has blue hair, wears a blue shirt with black pants and brown shoes with the Coat on his back.

item.name: Stone
item.overview: Stone wears a white shirt with a pink belt and bright blue pants with brown shoes and blue hair. He also uses the Mildly Irritated Face.

item.name: Swan
item.overview: The Swan wears a uniquely styled black and red shirt with crimson red sunglasses. He has black hair, and wears the Pink Coat on his back.

item.name: The Gorilla King
item.overview: The Gorilla King resembles Gorillas, but bigger. There are certain distinguishing features, such as the crown on its head, its different skin color and the Aura that covers its hands.

item.name: The Saw
item.overview: "The Saw has spawned in the game! You have 15 minutes to kill him and possibly get a rare reward!"

item.name: Thunder God
item.overview: The Thunder God wears brown, white, and blue pants with a blue ribbon and has the Tomoe Ring on his back. Despite this, he does not drop the Tomoe Ring.

item.name: Tide Keeper
item.overview: The Tide Keeper wears green pants with a green ribbon, golden skeletons on his shoulders, yellow shoes with green hair and the Dont Wake Me Up face.

item.name: Vice Admiral
item.overview: The Vice Admiral wears a white and red shirt which is open, black and white pants with red shoes, along with the Coat on his back. He has dark toned blue hair, and wields the Triple Katana upon encounter.

item.name: Warden
item.overview: The Warden sports a black bodysuit that covers his chest and legs, along with several metal plates and black bands on his torso, ankle and shoulders. He has well-defined muscles on his arms and wears a black helmet with blue horns on it.

item.name: Wysper
item.overview: Wysper wears a grey neck accessory with red sleeves as well as pink shorts with white ends, along with brown hair shaved on the sides. He uses the Furious George Face.

item.name: Yeti (Boss)
item.overview: The Yeti is a reskin of The Gorilla King boss. However, it does not have the same six-pack of the latter, and uses a different head model. It is covered from head to toe in whitish-blue fur, with flatter, ice-like surfaces on its hands and feet. On its face is a large, flat nose, white eyes with red tints and a large, open mouth with large and sharp teeth. It has fluffy hair and a long, mane-like beard appearing on both his head and neck.

item.name: Zero
item.overview: Zero is located on the 20th floor of a dungeon, specifically on Hard mode. He is typically the last boss you fight before the dungeon ends and you can claim your rewards (unless you're doing Challenge difficulty).
